commit 72689175377db2ca5b349abd25f6c93bda8774f8
Author:     Corey Bryant <corey@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Mon Feb 23 07:38:48 2026 +1300
Commit:     Corey Bryant <corey@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Mon Feb 23 07:38:48 2026 +1300

    Bug 2007074 - Ensure proper logic for setting MOZ_APP_PROFILE. r=dandarnell
    
    
    The prior logic always evaluated the if statement to true because
    target_is_windows was a non-none object.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D284315

diff --git a/mail/moz.configure b/mail/moz.configure
index 951078620bd..a781592a623 100644
--- a/mail/moz.configure
+++ b/mail/moz.configure
@@ -11,10 +11,8 @@ imply_option("MOZ_APP_NAME", "thunderbird")
 
 # MOZ_APP_PROFILE: When set, used for application.ini's
 # "Profile" field, which controls profile location.
-if target_is_windows or target_is_osx:
-    imply_option("MOZ_APP_PROFILE", "Thunderbird")
-else:
-    imply_option("MOZ_APP_PROFILE", "thunderbird")
+imply_option("MOZ_APP_PROFILE", "Thunderbird", when=target_is_windows | target_is_osx)
+imply_option("MOZ_APP_PROFILE", "thunderbird", when=~target_is_windows & ~target_is_osx)
 
 # MOZ_APP_BASENAME: Typically stays consistent for multiple branded
 # versions of a given application (e.g. Daily and Thunderbird both use
title: Bug 2007074 - Ensure proper logic for setting MOZ_APP_PROFILE. r=dandarnell
